description: This file defines the authentication-related API endpoints for a FastAPI backend, including login functionality and fetching current user info.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Schema for login request containing email and password.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response containing access token.

classes.name: User
classes.description: ORM model representing a user in the database.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates a user using email and password, returning a JWT token if successful.

methods.name: UserPublic me(user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns information about the currently authenticated user.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> TokenResponse:$/
